questions.prompt: Which command explicitly provisions a new machine in the active model without deploying an application yet?
questions.explanation: 'juju add-machine' allocates a new host instance in the cloud for later placement or manual orchestration.

questions.prompt: How do you securely open an interactive shell session into unit 'web/0'?
questions.explanation: 'juju ssh <target>' uses Juju's managed keys to establish a secure SSH session into a unit or machine.

questions.prompt: Which command removes an empty machine with ID 2 from the model?
questions.explanation: 'juju remove-machine <id>' decommissions the machine and releases its resources.
